title: 漓江清晨：你钱包里的那座山｜Li River, Guilin (桂林·兴坪)
description:
清晨的漓江，山在水里睡着。竹筏轻轻划开薄雾——你手里二十元人民币的背面，画的就是这里，兴坪。千年前，渔人带着鸬鹚出江；如今那盏渔火，多半只为旅人而亮。桂林山水甲天下，不是一句空话。老表，得闲来广西行行。

At dawn the Li River lies still, mountains sleeping in the water. A bamboo raft slips through the mist — and the scene on the back of your ¥20 note is right here, at Xingping. A thousand years ago fishermen worked these waters with cormorants; today that little fishing lamp glows mostly for travelers. "Guilin's scenery is the finest under heaven" is no empty boast. Laobiao — come wander Guangxi when you're free.

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税古筝音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free guzheng bed (no AI narration in this video).
